mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, user_id, refund_amount, refund_reason, refund_desc, evidence_images, apply_time, audit_status, audit_operator_id, audit_remark, audit_time, refund_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM refund_application WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status = #{auditStatus} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, order_id, order_no, user_id, refund_amount, refund_reason, refund_desc, evidence_images, apply_time, audit_status, audit_operator_id, audit_remark, audit_time, refund_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM refund_application WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_application SET audit_status = #{status}, audit_operator_id = #{operatorId}, audit_remark = #{remark}, audit_time = NOW(), refund_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 40 THEN NOW() ELSE refund_time END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND audit_status = 10
